title: Object Oriented
body:
The paradigm of organising a system around *things* rather than *functions*: data and the
operations on it live together in an [[Object]], defined by a [[Classes|class]]. See
[[Object Oriented Approach]] for the course's treatment (the OOAD pipeline and the claimed
benefits), [[Structured Approach]] for what it is being contrasted against, and [[Paradigms]]
for why either choice is a design decision rather than a language feature.

The four pillars: [[Abstraction]], [[Encapsulation]], [[Inheritance]], [[Polymorphism]].
